name: prim_spd_f
description: #606's AO parent for the aux ladder through i: He with one primitive s, p and d, Ne with one f contracted over two primitives, Ne off every axis. Every pair class (la <= lb <= 3) occurs. Records the converted basis and libcint's one-electron arrays.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate prim_spd_f
provenance.basis:
#BASIS SET: #606's parent: s, p, d on He, one contracted f on Ne
He S
  1.3 1.0
He P
  0.9 1.0
He D
  0.7 1.0
#BASIS SET: #606's parent: s, p, d on He, one contracted f on Ne
Ne F
  1.4 0.6
  0.55 0.5

density_recipe: hilbert: D[i][j] = 1/(i+j+1) -- symmetric positive definite, no RNG, reproducible bit-for-bit on any host
